## Appearance

Matthew Cuthbert is an odd-looking, ungainly man with stooping shoulders and long iron-gray hair that touches them, which has grown noticeably grayer over the course of a year. He has kindly brown eyes and wears a full, soft brown beard that he has kept since he was twenty years old.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P26](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0026)_

## Personality

Matthew Cuthbert is an exceptionally quiet, shy, and nervous man who notoriously dreads all women, with the exception of [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel, and possesses a particular mortal dread of little girls. Known for his silent nature, he rarely speaks and avoids going among strangers or places where he might be forced to converse, though he is recognized as a remarkably sympathetic listener with a wordless smile of enjoyment. Despite his quiet demeanor, he is patient, wise, and good-natured, never scolding others and possessing a loving disposition. While argument is not his strong point, he is characterized by an amazing, silent persistency and holds fast to his opinions once a whim takes hold. Rather than seeking out excitement, he remains steadfast in his goals, strongly desiring to keep [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and maintaining a firm conviction that she will excel in her examinations.

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), having grown up before the new house was constructed, and wore a full soft brown beard from the age of twenty while dealing with heart trouble. His life changed dramatically when he set off for [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station expecting to collect an orphan boy, only to discover an eleven-year-old girl named [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) waiting instead. Intrigued by her lively character during the ride home, Matthew quietly championed keeping her despite Marilla's initial shock and reluctance. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settled into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Matthew showed his fondness through small gestures, such as giving her chocolates and secretly encouraging her to apologize to Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to end a punishment. He quietly backed Anne's involvement in social events, supporting her desire to attend a local Christmas concert and secretly arranging with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to buy and sew a dress with puffed sleeves so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could fit in with her peers. Matthew beamed with pride over Anne's growth, academic achievements, and recitations, frequently encouraging her during her studies and celebrating her tying for first place on the entrance exams for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy). Upon her triumphant graduation from Queen's with an Avery scholarship, Matthew affectionately confessed to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how proud he was of her during a quiet evening at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). The very next day, Matthew suffered a fatal heart attack caused by the shock of reading a newspaper report detailing a local bank failure, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) in deep grief.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Matthew serves as a foster father to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after bringing her to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), despite the original plan to adopt a boy. Though shy, he quickly becomes a soft-spoken ally who views her as a kindred spirit, enjoying her imaginative chatter and secretly visiting her to gently coax her out of punishments. He delights in making her happy, often expressing his quiet affection through thoughtful gestures like gifting her chocolates.

- Parent of — foster father  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Matthew and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are brother and sister who live together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and share the responsibility of running the household. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is practical, strict, and inclined toward traditional discipline, Matthew is quiet and tender-hearted, often subtly influencing decisions regarding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their dynamic involves a gentle tug-of-war, with Matthew silently pushing to keep and indulge [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) focuses on her practical upbringing and religious instruction.

- Sibling of — brother and sister living together at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P7](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P27](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0027), +13 more</sub>
